items.originalAcceptance: 显示空格制表与段落结束，导出不写入可见符号

commonAcceptance.evidence: Inline/widget decorations display space, tab and paragraph markers while JSON, HTML, original text and formatting remain unchanged; actual component changes no document data.

The toolbar preserves selection; IME and input-control shortcuts are isolated. Closing the pure view removes decorations without a data draft; actual browser input retains the intended caret position.
View transactions use addToHistory=false. Model history depths, component text formatting undo/redo and actual browser text editing undo/redo remain correct after view toggles.
readOnly permits local viewing; disabled blocks all toggle routes and shortcuts. Component tests verify no onChange, and the browser verifies read-only viewing.

The final frozen browser run imports native DOCX, edits, downloads/reopens twice, resets the local preference and displays tabs again. Independent ZIP/XML checks all body/header/footer text has no injected view symbols.
Disabled/IME/input-control refusals issue no update or onChange. Toggling view does not modify serialized data or partially accept a data transaction.

items.originalAcceptance: 隐藏列、选区显示、全表显示与键盘导航

commonAcceptance.evidence: Selected-range and whole-sheet commands keep cell objects, formulas, dimensions, auto/fixed identities, other sheets and filters; model/UI and independent native XML checks pass.
Visible focus recovery, merged-cell navigation, Home/End and extended selection skip hidden columns/rows; IME and invalid drafts refuse mutation, Escape recovers the original draft.
Each hide/show uses the existing single transaction; model/UI and the actual imported-file browser flow verify one undo and redo. No-op commands retain document identity.
All six write commands are disabled in readOnly and disabled component states; actual browser verifies the read-only controls. Navigation remains available in readOnly mode.

Real XLSX source is imported, edited and downloaded/reopened twice; independent ZIP/XML verifies manual/filter overlap, row heights, sizing modes, widths and formula/cache. External unhide and legacy row insertion have native regressions.
Invalid ranges, all-hidden requests and malformed metadata fail atomically; invalid source bytes, legacy source/model and blocked command data remain unchanged.
